requirement.text: The driver shall acknowledge the level transitions, if requested from trackside.

classification.rationale: The requirement describes a driver interaction within the European Train Control System (ETCS / ERTMS), which is an onboard railway safety and signaling control system (an embedded/industrial system), rather than a web application, mobile application, or machine-learning system.

rounds.text_checked: The driver shall acknowledge the level transitions, if requested from trackside.

test_strategy.rationale: Decision table testing applies because the requirement contains conditional logic (whether trackside requests a transition and whether the driver acknowledges it) driving distinct system outcomes. State-based testing applies because ERTMS level transitions represent discrete state changes in system operation. Use case testing applies because there is a multi-step operational scenario and a known dependency with requirement PURE-ERTMS-R5 regarding the workflow and consequences of driver acknowledgment.

test_cases.title: Level transition requested from trackside with prompt driver acknowledgment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is operating on track with trackside level transition order requesting acknowledgment.
steps: 1. Trackside sends a level transition request requiring driver acknowledgment.
2. System prompts driver to acknowledge level transition on DMI.
3. Driver presses the acknowledgment button within the allowed time limit.
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts the acknowledgment, transitions to the requested ERTMS level, and continues normal operation without brake intervention.

test_cases.title: Level transition requested from trackside without driver acknowledgment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is operating on track with trackside level transition order requesting acknowledgment.
steps: 1. Trackside sends a level transition request requiring driver acknowledgment.
2. System prompts driver to acknowledge level transition on DMI.
3. Driver fails to acknowledge within the required time window.
test_cases.expected_result: The system registers the missing acknowledgment and triggers brake application safety action as per PURE-ERTMS-R5.

test_cases.title: Level transition requested without acknowledgment prompt requirement
test_cases.preconditions: Train is operating on track approaching an automatic level transition zone.
steps: 1. Trackside sends a level transition request that does NOT require driver acknowledgment.
2. Train reaches the level transition boundary.
test_cases.expected_result: System transitions level automatically without requiring driver acknowledgment or issuing an acknowledgment prompt on the DMI.

test_cases.title: State transition from ERTMS Level 1 to Level 2 upon trackside request and driver acknowledgment
test_cases.preconditions: Train is currently operating in ERTMS Level 1 state.
steps: 1. Train passes balise group announcing Level 2 transition requiring driver acknowledgment.
2. System enters 'Level Transition Pending Acknowledgment' state.
3. Driver acknowledges the transition via Driver Machine Interface (DMI).
test_cases.expected_result: System transitions state from Level 1 to Level 2 and confirms active Level 2 status.

test_cases.title: State transition timeout handling when level transition acknowledgment is ignored
test_cases.preconditions: Train is operating in ERTMS Level 2 state approaching Level 1 area.
steps: 1. Trackside orders level transition to Level 1 requiring acknowledgment.
2. System enters 'Level Transition Pending' state and starts acknowledgment timer.
test_cases.expected_result: System transitions to 'Brake Application' state per requirement PURE-ERTMS-R5 due to unacknowledged level transition.

test_cases.title: End-to-End Operational Workflow for Trackside Requested Level Transition
test_cases.preconditions: Train is in commercial service under ERTMS supervision.
steps: 1. Train receives trackside level transition command requiring driver acknowledgment.
2. DMI displays visual signal and emits audible alert for level transition acknowledgment.
3. Driver acknowledges transition within time limit.
4. Train enters new ERTMS level zone successfully.
test_cases.expected_result: Level transition completes successfully, DMI displays new active ERTMS level, and continuous supervision proceeds under new level rules.

final_text: The driver shall acknowledge the level transitions, if requested from trackside.
